_help.about: Copy this file to db.config.json and fill in your own values. db.config.json is gitignored.
_help.defaults: Applied to any connection that omits a value. access can be read, readwrite, or full.
_help.access: read = SELECT/WITH only. readwrite = also INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE. full = also DDL and EXEC.
_help.connections: Define one entry per database. The key is the connection name you use in Claude.
_help.templates: Optional. Generate many connections from a pattern. {var} placeholders come from variables. A variable is a list of values, or a map of value to per-value overrides (password, access, etc.). Leave templates as [] if unused.
_help.vpn: mode = none (direct), wait (you connect the VPN yourself; use for Entra ID/OAuth+MFA), or command (server runs connectCommand). For wait/command, probeTarget is optional.
_help.docs: See README.md for full details and examples.
